text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Festa? You don't have
the guts to
bet on my life?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I don't really even have to ask. I
think
the both of us already know the
answer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You either race for me or you race to
win... It's
one of the two.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You need to choose the one that
electrifies and
inspires you to race with
authenticity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: B-but if I do that, you—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Festa. The desire to see results...
that's called
"hope."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'll have hope for you no matter what
path you
pick.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Watching you live gave me hope... I
looked up to
you for continuing to chase
after your goal.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
When you think of victory, what do you
envision?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll follow you even if it takes me to the
depths of
hell.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All of you are out of your minds.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Once I decide, I'm not gonna be able
to take it
back.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nakayama? Is that a sign-up sheet
you're
holding for the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It sure is. Trainer, El... I've made my
decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rip!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is my gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Victory to me is winning the Prix de l'Arc
de
Triomphe a year from now, while
Teach is still
alive to see it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If both conditions aren't met, I lose. It
makes my
chances of winning close to
zero.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's a risk that makes my heart throb.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Takarazuka Kinen
comes
along.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day I show everyone
something
they've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, it's time t'do this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You prepared to go up against Spe?
She's got
experience representing Japan
against
international racers, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
They don't call her the Ruler of Japan
for nothing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...So the next time I see you, you'll have

graduated to a whole different level.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Win and give the signal, then I'll let the
condor fly
again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer. It's between me
and her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's time that I get on the track.
